actions.area: Creatures within a 20-ft.-radius spread centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates Diabolos’s ability to put all creatures in a 20-ft
description.value: The caster emulates Diabolos’s ability to put all creatures in a 20-ft.-radius area into a nightmarish slumber. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save or be inflicted with Sleep status effect and lowers their attack rolls by 1d6 for 1d6 rounds. Learned From Diabolos and Kaiser Dragon.
